data_domains: population census; consumer price index; foreign trade; vital statistics; labour force; household income and expenditure; MICS; family health survey; ICT indicators
notes: Official NSO. Publication catalogue exposed via wp-sitemap-posts-*.xml under economic_statistics, demog_statist, vital-administrative and social_statistics post types. Front-end listing pages are JavaScript-rendered; enumerate via sitemap instead.

data_domains: quarterly economic bulletin; money supply; monetary base; required reserves; consolidated commercial bank balance sheet; capital adequacy; currency in circulation; balance of payments; foreign trade; uses of foreign exchange; exchange rates; annual reports; financial stability
notes: Richest continuous Libyan macro series. Monetary tables run 2004 to present. Uses-of-foreign-exchange releases are cumulative year-to-date and monthly. Daily exchange rate table on site. English site under /en/.

data_domains: monthly financial report; transparency report; budget legislation; circulars
notes: Sections: /reports/, /transparency_report/, /publications/, /legislation/. Actual release cadence needs verification against archived snapshots.

data_domains: annual report on public finance and institutional performance; audit findings by ministry and state company
notes: Returns HTTP 200 with an empty body to scripted clients. Annual reports are the single most detailed public account of Libyan state spending and institutional performance. Retrieve manually or via web archive.

data_domains: administrative oversight reports; public employment and disciplinary decisions
notes: Reachable. Content inventory pending.

data_domains: tax law texts (Law1.aspx executive, Law2.aspx administrative); circulars
notes: WARNING: homepage carries injected SEO spam linking to gambling and unrelated domains, indicating the site is compromised. Do not treat any document served from this host as authenticated without cross-checking. Flagged 2026-09-09.

data_domains: customs tariffs; import and export procedures
notes: Returns HTTP 403 to datacenter IPs.

data_domains: register of licensed companies; circulars and announcements; regulated-occupation registry
notes: /licensed-companies/ is a usable firm-level register. /duty-registration-jobs/ lists regulated occupations.

data_domains: listed securities; trading data
notes: Domain 301-redirects to a bare IP (41.208.106.218) that does not serve a site. Treat as defunct; use LCMA and CBL for capital market data instead.

data_domains: annual reports; financial statements
notes: Reachable. Content inventory pending.

data_domains: annual reports; portfolio disclosures; governance documents
notes: Alternate domain libyaninvestment.com sits behind a Cloudflare interstitial and is not scriptable.

data_domains: crude production levels; benchmark oil prices; production statements; financial reports; exploration and sustainability reports
notes: Homepage shows current production and a daily benchmark price panel (Brent, Dubai, Urals, WTI, OPEC basket). /reports/ exists but exposes few downloadable files; most production figures are published through press releases rather than as tables.

data_domains: company operational reports
notes: NOC subsidiary. Content inventory pending.

data_domains: company operational reports
notes: NOC subsidiary based in Benghazi. Content inventory pending.

data_domains: company operational reports
notes: Returns HTTP 403 to datacenter IPs. NOC and ENI joint operator.

data_domains: election results; voter registration statistics; candidate lists; constituency boundaries; polling centre lists
notes: Behind a Sucuri WAF that blacklists datacenter IP ranges (block ID BLACK02). Reachable from ordinary residential browsers. Covers 2012 GNC, 2014 HoR, 2014 CDA and the 2024-2026 municipal election phases. Highest-value untapped source for Libyan political science.

data_domains: official gazette by legislative year; plenary session records; statements by year 2015-2023; standing committee membership
notes: Official Gazette (الجريدة الرسمية) organised by legislative year. Statements archived under year categories 2015 through 2023. Session records under /category/الجلسات/. Usable for legislative output and roll-of-members research.

data_domains: cabinet decisions; prime ministerial decrees; press statements
notes: Executive decisions of the Tripoli-based government. Re-probed 2026-09-12: pm.gov.ly now serves a placeholder page with an injected SEO link farm, 189 outbound hosts, and publishes no decisions. The decisions are at gnu.gov.ly instead, on a WordPress REST API with renamed paths (/lefunot/ for wp-json): 648 records dated 2021 to 2024-09, carrying title, date and issuing authority only, with no body text and no attached PDF.

data_domains: state newswire archive with sequential post identifiers
notes: URL pattern post.php?lang=ar&id=NNNNNN with sequential IDs (~365,000 as of 2026-09) makes the full archive systematically harvestable. Strong candidate for a text corpus on official framing.

data_domains: EWARN early warning surveillance; COVID-19 epidemiological situation reports; multisectoral NCD strategy 2026-2030; scientific and administrative reports
notes: Reports live under تقارير وبحوث. Some documents are hosted on Google Drive rather than the domain, so links are fragile and need mirroring.

data_domains: health facility and service statistics; ministerial decisions
notes: Behind the same Sucuri WAF as HNEC (block ID BLACK02). Reachable from residential browsers.

data_domains: ministerial decisions and legislation; training and employment forms
notes: Decisions and legislation only. No employment statistics published; labour force data comes from BSC instead.

data_domains: contributor and beneficiary statistics; pension administration
notes: Behind Sucuri WAF. Potentially a major source of administrative microdata on formal employment and pensions.

data_domains: education policy; admission and enrolment policy; examination regulations; private education administration
notes: No enrolment statistics published on the ministry site itself.

data_domains: secondary certificate examination results and pass rates
notes: Under the Ministry of Education. Examination results by school and region are the closest available proxy for education outcomes at subnational level.

data_domains: statistics section; reports; import and export documentation; daily commodity prices; official exchange rates; investment map; joint company and commercial agency registers; agreements
notes: /daily-rates/ publishes daily commodity prices, useful as an independent price series alongside the BSC CPI. /investment-map/ and the commercial agency registers are firm-level.

data_domains: agricultural policy and programme documentation
notes: Site served under a /2020/ path prefix. Content inventory pending.
